solution_sketch: Cross-multiply: 3 × 9 = 27 and 4 × 7 = 28. Since 28 > 27, the fraction with numerator 4 (i.e. 4/9) is larger. Equivalently, over common denominator 63 the fractions are 27/63 and 28/63.
difficulty_rationale: Naive route is to convert both to a common denominator (LCM 63): 3/7 = 27/63, 4/9 = 28/63 — five distinct multiplications and a comparison, tight in 20 s without paper. The insight is to cross-multiply once: 3·9 vs 4·7, i.e. 27 vs 28 — a single comparison that lands in a few seconds. The values are deliberately close (differ by 1/63) so 'guessing by feel' does not settle it, forcing the reader to actually pick a method.
